w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE CALLBACK! Tashi, Max join you!

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "The audience is bored of the rerun. Do something they haven’t seen."
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "That's not an honor. It's just what the aliens like to see. You're going on television."
📺 SYSTEM: "YOUR DRAMA, AIRED BACK. They kept the tapes. All of them."
📺 SYSTEM: "The audience is bored of the rerun. Do something they haven’t seen."
📺 SYSTEM: "● LIVE — Break Room. YOU is on television."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/10/7), with 9 wave-4 fought, 13 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 16 · Craft 8 · Talk 21 · Explore 39 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ OUTSHONE — Ethan Hunt did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,031 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Phase Shawl. Sometimes your shoulder isn't where the spear lands. The shawl knows. Don't ask how. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
